questionText: Let S be the specification: "Instructors teach courses. Students register for courses. Courses are allocated classrooms. Instructors guide students." Which one of the following ER diagrams CORRECTLY represents S?
explanation:
Step 1: Identify Entity Sets and Relationship Sets in Specification S

From the specification S:
1. "Instructors teach courses": Instructor (Entity) and Course (Entity) are connected via Teaches (Relationship).
2. "Students register for courses": Student (Entity) and Course (Entity) are connected via Registration (Relationship).
3. "Courses are allocated classrooms": Course (Entity) and Classroom (Entity) are connected via Allocation (Relationship).
4. "Instructors guide students": Instructor (Entity) and Student (Entity) are connected via Guides (Relationship).

Step 2: Check standard ER diagram representations
- Rectangles represent Entities: Instructor, Course, Student, Classroom.
- Diamonds represent Relationships: Teaches, Registration, Allocation, Guides.

Step 3: Analyze the options
- In diagram (iv):
  • Instructor and Course connect via diamond Teaches.
  • Course and Classroom connect via diamond Allocation.
  • Course and Student connect via diamond Registration.
  • Instructor and Student connect via diamond Guides.

All entities (Instructor, Course, Classroom, Student) are represented as rectangles and all relationship sets (Teaches, Allocation, Registration, Guides) are represented as diamonds connecting the appropriate entities.

Therefore, diagram (iv) correctly represents specification S, which corresponds to option (D).
